title: 第一卷 第1章 仙门第一卷 第2章 考核
lines: “你这阴魂不散的色胚，居然又来了！”
眼前白衣胜雪的女子柳眉微蹙，哪怕是嗔怒的模样，也如此娇俏动人。
黑暗的空间仿佛因她的存在而明亮了几分，只可惜她手中握着一把泛着寒光的蓝白长剑。
林风眠看着那把蓝白长剑，身上都开始幻痛了，不由悲从中来。
自己在玉仙宗被妖女欺负，好不容易做个春梦，还要被梦中的女子欺负？
“不就是个梦吗，今天小爷我非收拾了你这小娘皮！”
他把心一横，向着那白衣女子扑了过去，打定主意要丈量大小，试试深浅。
白衣女子被林风眠突如其来的动作吓了一跳，下意识一剑斩出。
林风眠只感觉一股剧痛传来，反而被激起了狠劲，伸手狠狠在女子胸前一抓。
白衣女子顿时瞪大了美目，而后气急败坏，手中长剑挥舞不断。
“你这登徒子，给我死！！！！”
林风眠感觉自己都快被劈成臊子了，一股锥心的剧痛传来。
他猛地坐起来，大口喘气，浑身摸了一遍，发现五肢俱全，才长舒一口气。
林风眠擦了擦额头上的汗，骂道：“艹，这梦也太真实，太吓人了！”
说到这里，他看着自己的手掌，忍不住轻轻捏了捏，似乎在回味什么。
看不出来，还挺有料？
但那锥心的剧痛，让林风眠忍不住打了个寒颤。
三个月前，他就频频做这古怪的梦境，总是梦见那个白衣胜雪的绝美仙子。
林风眠本以为自己在做春梦，便扑了上去，想试试逼不逼真。
虽然成功抱上了，手感还不错，却被梦中的仙子一剑给斩了。
林风眠本以为是在玉仙宗压力太大，日有所思夜有所梦，也没当一回事。
谁知道过几天，又做了相同的梦。
林风眠自然是要找回场子的，想让这女人尝尝林大少爷的厉害。
结果他还没靠近，就被这女人一剑给劈了！
自那以后，林风眠就一直重复这个变成噩梦的春梦。
而梦中的仙子到后面，连流程都给省了，见面就一剑招呼过来。
这三个月来，林风眠换着花样死了一遍，整个人都快崩溃了。
再这样下去，玉仙宗的妖女没弄死自己，梦中的女鬼就要先收了自己。
林风眠以手扶额，苦思冥想，自己为什么会做这古怪的梦境？
他目光落在了自己身前的玉佩上，神色凝重了起来。
这是林家的家传宝物，一块双鱼衔尾的阴阳玉佩。
三个月前，林风眠埋尸时不慎划破手指，将血染到玉佩上。
他从中获得了一门名为《邪帝诀》的功法，也是从那时候起，便开始做那古怪的梦境。
这女人该不会就寄宿在这块玉佩里面吧？
content_en:
"You lingering pervert is here again!"
The woman in white clothes in front of her frowned slightly, even if she looked angry, she was so charming and charming.
The dark space seemed to be a little brighter due to her presence, but it was a pity that she held a blue and white sword with a cold light in her hand.
Lin Fengmian looked at the blue and white sword, and felt phantom pain all over his body, and couldn't help but feel sad.
I was bullied by a demon girl in the Jade Immortal Sect. I finally had an erotic dream and was bullied by the woman in the dream?
"Isn't it just a dream? I have to deal with your little bitch today!"
He suddenly rushed towards the woman in white clothes, determined to measure the size and test the depth.
The woman in white was startled by Lin Fengmian's sudden movement and subconsciously slashed out with her sword.
Lin Fengmian only felt a sharp pain coming from her. Instead, he was aroused and reached out to grab the woman's chest.
The woman in white suddenly widened her beautiful eyes, and then became furious, waving the sword in her hand continuously.
"You bastard, die!!!!"
Lin Fengmian felt like he was about to be chopped into pieces, and a sharp pain came from his heart.
"Ah!"
He sat up suddenly, gasping for air, and felt all over his body. He breathed a sigh of relief when he found that all his limbs were intact.
Lin Fengmian wiped the sweat from his forehead and cursed: "Fuck, this dream is too real, too scary!"
Having said this, he looked at his palm and couldn't help but squeeze it gently, as if he was reminiscing about something.
Can't you tell, it's quite interesting?
But the sharp pain in his heart made Lin Fengmian couldn't help but shudder.
Three months ago, he had been having this weird dream frequently, always dreaming of the beautiful fairy in white clothes who outshone the snow.
Lin Fengmian thought he was having an erotic dream, so he pounced on her, trying to see if it was realistic.
Although he successfully hugged her and felt good in the hand, he was killed by the sword of the fairy in the dream.
Lin Fengmian originally thought that he was under too much pressure in the Jade Immortal Sect and thought about it day and night, but he didn't take it seriously.
Who knew that a few days later, I would have the same dream again.
Lin Fengmian naturally wanted to regain his position and wanted this woman to have a taste of how powerful Young Master Lin was.
As a result, before he even got close, he was struck by this woman's sword!
Since then, Lin Fengmian has been repeating this erotic dream that turned into a nightmare.
But when the fairy in the dream came to the back, even the process was omitted, and she greeted him with a sword when she met.
In the past three months, Lin Fengmian died in various ways, and his whole body was about to collapse.
If this continues, if the witch from the Jade Immortal Sect doesn't kill him, the female ghost in his dream will take him in first.
Lin Fengmian put his hand on his forehead and thought hard, why did he have this weird dream?
His eyes fell on the jade pendant in front of him, and his expression became serious.
This is a heirloom of the Lin family, a yin-yang jade pendant with two fishes at the end.
Three months ago, Lin Fengmian accidentally cut his finger while burying the body and stained the jade pendant with blood.
He obtained a skill called "Evil Emperor Technique" from it, and from that time on, he began to have weird dreams.
Could this woman be living in this jade pendant?
